name: n8n
param_style: TypeORM (@n8n/typeorm) query builders and repository finders; named :params and :...lists are emitted as ? on SQLite; a few raw sql`` templates (insights compaction)
schema_source: reconstructed final-state SQLite DDL from the TypeORM entities (packages/@n8n/db/src/entities) and the sqlite/common migrations; only the tables the queries use
data_scale: scale 1: 50 projects (40 personal, 10 team), 1.5k workflows with shares/tags/folders, 80k executions (+ execution_data, 20k metadata rows, 4k annotations), 1.2k webhooks, ~107k insights_by_period rows (hour/day/week + an uncompacted 2025 backlog), 5k insights_raw
visibility_note: ~209k stars; SQLite is the default database for self-hosted n8n
interest_note: TypeORM-emitted SQL: access control as a correlated EXISTS over shared_workflow/project/project_relation, a derived-table + left-join executions list, TypeORM's DISTINCT distinctAlias pagination wrapper, insights dashboards with a literal-date CTE, SUM(CASE) series and strftime/date() bucketing in GROUP BY, and an INSERT ... SELECT ... GROUP BY ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE compaction upsert.
reach_note: large self-hosted install base; SQLite is the default DB
